method: Nested prefixes, each the previous plus one part, sent at max_tokens=1; every part's size is the difference between two consecutive prompt_tokens counts as the provider reported them. The first three prefixes do not vary by document and were measured once; the document-sections figure is the mean over the 3 documents sampled.
caveat: A token may span the boundary between two parts, so a part's count can differ by one from that part tokenized alone. The parts are never sent alone, and the figure published is what each part ADDS to the billed prompt.
